cues: A freewheel lets the rear hub coast while the pedals remain motionless, separating wheel rotation from leg movement.
Sealed headset bearings turn beneath a compression cap, helping the steering assembly pivot smoothly without grinding.
A derailleur cage carries two small pulleys that guide the chain and keep it taut.
Tubeless-compatible rims have shaped bead seats that help tire edges hold an airtight seal.
A close-fitting racing helmet has narrow vents that channel airflow across the rider’s head.
A compact repair stand grips a seatpost or frame tube, lifting the wheels clear for maintenance.
